logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of iridium complexes was determined using the shake-flask method. Initially, the iridium complexes (10 mM in DMSO) were diluted into 0.15 mM in three different mixtures: (i) a1: 1 ratio of octanol: PBS, (ii) a 2: 1 ratio of octanol: PBS, and (iii) a 1: 2 ratio of octanol: PBS. The mixtures were shaken vigorously, and the solutions were allowed to settle for approximately 30 min until complete phase separation occurred. After separation, each phase was analyzed by UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy. The concentration of the iridium complex in each phase was determined using a calibration curve. The partition coefficients of the iridium complexes were then calculated using the formula Log P = log ([Ir]Oct / [Ir]PBS), where [Ir]Oct represents the concentration of the iridium in octanol, and [Ir]PBS represents the concentration of iridium in PBS. The Log P reportedis the average value obtained from triplicate runs.
